selected_rules.name: High‑Value COD in Extreme‑RTO Pincodes
selected_rules.description: Flags large‑value COD orders placed in pincodes whose historic RTO rate is exceptionally high.
selected_rules.rationale: A pincode with a rolling RTO rate above 60 % already indicates delivery‑failure propensity. When the merchant also ships a costly COD order (≥ ₹4 000), the expected loss per fraud (₹250) is dwarfed by the potential logistics and restocking cost, making this a high‑impact fraud slice with a low false‑positive likelihood.
